# viettelcloud_custom_image (Resource)

Manage a Viettel Cloud custom image created from a volume. Import an existing volume-backed image with its UUID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "source_volume" {
  type        = string
  default     = null
  description = "Name of an available bootable volume in the provider project."
}
variable "source_volume_id" {
  type        = string
  default     = null
  description = "UUID of an available bootable volume in the provider project. Set exactly one source variable."
}
resource "viettelcloud_custom_image" "example" {
  name = "my-custom-image"
  volume = {
    name = var.source_volume
    id   = var.source_volume_id
  }
  disk_format = "qcow2"
  description = "Reusable boot image"
  os          = "Linux"
  version     = "1"
  state       = "enabled"
  metadata    = jsonencode({ managed_by = "terraform" })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `disk_format` (String) Disk format: raw or qcow2. Changing this value replaces the image.
- `name` (String) Image name.

### Optional

- `container_format` (String) Container format: bare. Changing a configured value replaces the image.
- `description` (String) Image description. Omission preserves the backend value. An empty string clears the value.
- `metadata` (String) Image metadata as a JSON object. Configured values must be strings. Omission preserves metadata. Use {} to clear metadata.
- `os` (String) Operating system. Omission preserves the backend value. An empty string clears the value.
- `shared_projects` (Attributes Set) Projects that can use this image. Omission preserves sharing. Use an empty set to stop sharing. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--shared_projects))
- `state` (String) Image state: enabled or disabled. Omission preserves the backend value.
- `version` (String) Operating system version. Omission preserves the backend value. An empty string clears the value.
- `volume` (Attributes) Source volume. Configure exactly one of name or id. Changing a configured criterion replaces the image. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--volume))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time in RFC3339 format.
- `encrypt_key_size` (String) Encryption key size reported by the API.
- `id` (String) Image UUID.
- `min_volume_size` (Number) Minimum volume size reported by the API.
- `owner` (String) Owner username. Null when the API omits the owner.
- `owner_id` (String) Owner user UUID. Null when the API omits the owner.
- `project` (String) Owner project name.
- `project_id` (String) Owner project UUID.
- `region` (String) Region name.
- `size` (Number) Image size reported by the API.
- `status` (String) Backend image status.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC3339 format.

<a id="nestedatt--shared_projects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `shared_projects`

Optional:

- `id` (String) Project ID (UUID). Required when the reference is configured.


<a id="nestedatt--volume"></a>
### Nested Schema for `volume`

Optional:

- `id` (String) Source volume ID (UUID). The volume must belong to the provider project.
- `name` (String) Source volume name. Exactly one volume must match in the provider project.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import viettelcloud_custom_image.example <custom-image-uuid>
```
